paragraphs.source_en: Kieran strikes me in the face when he sees me back in the township. Loran cannot speak, while Eo’s father slumps against a wall. They think they failed me. I hear Eo’s mother’s cries. My mother says nothing as she makes me a meal. I don’t feel well. It’s hard to breathe. Leanna comes in late and helps her, kissing me on the head as I eat, lingering long enough to smell my hair. I must use one hand as I move the food from plate to mouth. My mother holds my other hand between her calloused palms. She watches it instead of me, as though remembering when it was small and soft and wondering how it became so hard.

units.source_en: Kieran strikes me in the face when he sees me back in the township.
Loran cannot speak, while Eo’s father slumps against a wall.
They think they failed me.
I hear Eo’s mother’s cries.
My mother says nothing as she makes me a meal.
I don’t feel well.
It’s hard to breathe.
Leanna comes in late and helps her, kissing me on the head as I eat, lingering long enough to smell my hair.
I must use one hand as I move the food from plate to mouth.
My mother holds my other hand between her calloused palms.
She watches it instead of me, as though remembering when it was small and soft and wondering how it became so hard.

paragraphs.source_en: I finish the meal just as Ugly Dan comes. My mother does not leave the table as I’m pulled away. Her eyes stay fixed on where my hand lay. I think she believes if she does not look up, this will not happen. Even she can only bear so much.

units.source_en: I finish the meal just as Ugly Dan comes.

ja.t: えたちょうどそのとき、

paragraphs.source_en: They hang me before a full assembly at nine in the morning. I’m dizzy for some reason. My heart feels funny, slow. I hear the ArchGovernor’s words to my wife echo.

units.source_en: They hang me before a full assembly at nine in the morning.
I’m dizzy for some reason.
My heart feels funny, slow.
I hear the ArchGovernor’s words to my wife echo.
“Is that all your strength?”

paragraphs.source_en: My people sing, we dance, we love. That is our strength. But we also dig. And then we die. Seldom do we get to choose why. That choice is power. That choice has been our only weapon. But it is not enough.

units.source_en: My people sing, we dance, we love.
That is our strength.
But we also dig.
And then we die.
Seldom do we get to choose why.

ja.t: べることは、めったにない。

units.source_en: That choice is power.
That choice has been our only weapon.
But it is not enough.

paragraphs.source_en: They give me my last words. I call Dio up. Her eyes are bloodshot and swollen. She’s a fragile thing, so unlike her sister.

units.source_en: They give me my last words.
I call Dio up.
Her eyes are bloodshot and swollen.
She’s a fragile thing, so unlike her sister.

paragraphs.source_en: “What were Eo’s last words?” I ask her, though my mouth moves slowly, oddly.

units.source_en: “What were Eo’s last words?”
I ask her, though my mouth moves slowly, oddly.

paragraphs.source_en: She glances back to Mother, who finally followed but now shakes her head. There is something they are not telling me. Something they don’t want me to know. A secret held back even though I am about to die.

units.source_en: She glances back to Mother, who finally followed but now shakes her head.
There is something they are not telling me.
Something they don’t want me to know.
A secret held back even though I am about to die.

ja.t: ぬというのに、それでも

units.source_en: “She said she loved you.”

paragraphs.source_en: I don’t believe her, but I smile and kiss her forehead. She can’t handle more questions. And I’m dizzy. Hard to speak.

units.source_en: I don’t believe her, but I smile and kiss her forehead.
She can’t handle more questions.
And I’m dizzy.
Hard to speak.
“I’ll tell her you say hello.”

paragraphs.source_en: I do not sing. I am made for other things.

units.source_en: I do not sing.
I am made for other things.

paragraphs.source_en: My death is senseless. It is love.

units.source_en: My death is senseless.
It is love.

paragraphs.source_en: But Eo was right, I don’t understand this. This is not my victory. This is selfish. She told me to live for more. She wanted me to fight. But here I am, dying despite what she wanted. Giving up because of the pain.

units.source_en: But Eo was right, I don’t understand this.

ja.t: にはこれがわかっていない。

units.source_en: This is not my victory.

She wanted me to fight.
But here I am, dying despite what she wanted.
Giving up because of the pain.

paragraphs.source_en: I panic as suicides do when they realize their folly.

units.source_en: I panic as suicides do when they realize their folly.
Too late.

paragraphs.source_en: I feel the door beneath me open. My body falls. Rope flays my neck. My spine creaks. Needles lance my lumbar. Kieran stumbles forward. Uncle Narol shoves him away. With a wink, he touches my feet and pulls.

paragraphs.source_en: I hope they do not bury me.

paragraphs.source_en: There is a festival where we wear the faces of demons to ward evil spirits from our dead in the vale. Sometimes we fail.
